description: This file defines the interface class IOcdmSession for managing CDM (Content Decryption Module) sessions, including methods for session construction, challenge data handling, decryption, and session management within the Rialto media server component.

classes.name: IOcdmSession
classes.description: An interface class for managing CDM sessions, providing methods for session lifecycle, challenge data handling, decryption, and key management.

methods.name: constructSession
methods.description: Constructs a new CDM session with specified session and data types.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for the session, optionally for LDL.

methods.name: storeLicenseData
methods.description: Stores license challenge data for the session.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the data of the key session.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Processes a response for the key session.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Deprecated method for decrypting GstBuffer with additional parameters.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes all data related to the session.

methods.name: cancelChallengeData
methods.description: Cancels an in-progress challenge data operation.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a key in the session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the internal CDM key session ID.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session (Netflix API).

methods.name: hasKeyId
methods.description: Checks if the session contains a specific key ID.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for the session.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.
